title: [3.0-beta1] Automation issues with temporary/durational %profile change
symptom: Automation with precondition 'Profile pct is equal to 100' is ignored, causing the automation to run multiple times. Also, the end time for profile duration doesn't update when automation is renewed, leading to negative countdown.
cause: The profile switch done by the first automation is not taken into account during the evaluation of the second automation rule, possibly due to timing because the profile switch takes some seconds to be applied.
